description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Ban' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Ban levels and the level ban gates apply to a player. The publisher defines any number of named levels (e.g. "low"/"medium"/"hard") — each with capability checkboxes (BanCapability: block withdrawals, deposits, leaderboards, trading, PvP, chat, social, coop, referral, push, community marketing, crypto convert, purchases) plus an optional BlockLogin flag that shuts the player out of the game entirely and overrides everything else on that level. DefaultLevelID is the level a manual ban applies when the caller does not pick one. Two built-in ids always work even when not listed here: "hard" (blocks login) and "soft" (synthesized from the legacy Soft section below). Use PLAYER-facing tools (SetPlayerBanStatus) to actually ban a player with a level ID from here — this section only defines what each level MEANS.

x-enum-descriptions: Blocks crypto/NFT withdrawal. Deposits are never blocked by any ban level — funds already committed on-chain must land somewhere.
Player stops earning leaderboard scores and is removed from the ranked top.
Blocks the player-to-player marketplace and trade offers (send/accept).
Blocks PvP matches, board attacks/raids and the community chest, and hides the player from other players' opponent/bot pools.
Blocks the chat module entirely (read included).
Blocks Community Marketing entirely (earnings become unreachable).
Blocks converting virtual currency to/from crypto.
Blocks real-money purchases (Purchase module — Google/Apple IAP).

BlockLogin.description: Blocks the player out of the game entirely: no v2 request succeeds, login/refresh issue no tokens. Overrides every Capabilities/BlockedModules/BlockedActions entry on this level.

BlockedActions.description: Additional per-module action blocklist beyond what Capabilities already cover. Module -> action names, matched case-insensitively.

BlockedModules.description: Additional modules blocked entirely, beyond what Capabilities already cover. FunctionName values, e.g. "Blockchain", "MarketplaceV2". Matched case-insensitively; an unknown name simply never matches and never breaks the request.

Capabilities.description: Named restrictions this level applies — see BanCapability for exactly what each one closes. Prefer these over BlockedModules/BlockedActions; use the latter only for something a capability does not cover.

DefaultDurationHours.description: Default ban duration in hours when this level is applied without an explicit duration (manual ban or AutoBan rule). Null = indefinite.

Description.description: Optional note for the publisher explaining what this level is for.

Name.description: Display name shown in the dashboard, e.g. "Hard", "Medium", "Light".

PlayerMessage.description: Text shown to the banned player instead of the generic ban message. Null = generic message.

Severity.description: Sort order — higher is stricter. Used by AutoBan escalation to tell whether a step would upgrade or downgrade the current ban.

value.description: New value for the Ban field.

DefaultLevelID.description: Level id applied by a manual ban that does not specify one, and by AutoBan rules that do not specify one. Must be a key of Levels.

Levels.description: Ban levels the publisher has configured, keyed by a slug the publisher picks (e.g. "low", "medium", "hard"). Any number of levels, any names. The platform reserves no id.
